reading.body:
The data cannot determine whether this Omaha facility currently supports AI workloads, as no power capacity is recorded and Verizon does not publish details on this site's customer base or use cases.

Two Verizon entries in this registry share the same address in Omaha, located roughly 90 meters apart on a street named for the facility itself. Research flags them as likely the same campus or adjacent buildings rather than separate locations. This suggests the registry still contains duplicates in areas where operators do not maintain public facility directories, and where commercial real estate listings alone cannot resolve the question.

Verizon's internal network switching and data facilities operate differently from the colocation sites that publish customer lists. Without published specifications or customer data, it remains unclear what traffic this location handles or whether it processes AI inference, training, or neither. The address is confirmed and the facility is real. What it does is not recorded here.
